_written: 2026-11-02, before gnomAD data were downloaded or any proxy-class result was viewed. Preview of grant Aim 1B on existing LDLR data; exploratory.
source: gnomAD v4.1 (dataset gnomad_r4) via the public GraphQL API, region chr19:11089285-11089495 (oligo 21-231), SNVs only; genomes and exomes combined (AC and AN summed; a variant absent from one is counted with that dataset's AN missing, i.e. AF from the dataset(s) where it is present). Variants failing gnomAD filters are kept but flagged.

reference_classes.clinvar_plp: ClinVar Pathogenic, Likely pathogenic or P/LP SNV (step-3 table)
reference_classes.clinvar_blb: ClinVar Benign or Likely benign SNV
reference_classes.not_in_gnomad: designed SNV not observed in gnomAD

measures.activity: Kircher 2019 LDLR log2 effect; abnormal = P < 1e-5 (the significance line of the plasmid Fiber-seq paper Fig. 6a) in LDLR and same sign in LDLR.2
measures.nucleosome: change in molecules with a confident >= 81-bp call (repeat3.py endpoint, A7 mask, HepG2 run 3); abnormal = |D / se| > 3.29 (two-sided P < 0.001)
measures.footprint: any fp_features significant footprint change (A7 mask, confident calls; BH within SNV)
measures.either: abnormal in activity or in nucleosome

report: per class: n SNVs, n abnormal and fraction (Wilson 95% CI) for each measure; median activity and nucleosome change. Comparisons are descriptive (classes overlap and are small). No calibration (OddsPath) is computed here.
caveats_known_before_running: 6 B/LB and 8 P/LP SNVs only; gnomAD promoter coverage depends on genome depth; many element SNVs are expected to be absent from gnomAD.
